latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Free App Download — Create and Export Videos Online.

- Instantly upload video clips (up to 500MB) and use simple natural language commands to trim, add music, and export 1080p MP4 videos.
- No need to install a desktop app; all processing happens on fast cloud GPUs.
- Seamless setup with anonymous authentication—100 free credits, no account required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and other popular video/audio formats.
- Includes built-in error handling for token, session, credits, and file compatibility issues.
- User-friendly prompts and workflow: upload, edit, export, and download—typically ready in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
